name: Chase the Ace Ranking
author: Mauricio Bridge
description: Class ranking for Chase the Ace finals following the 2026 MultiGP Rules & Regulations (7.9.2): first to 2 Aces (win + completing the laps), void races when nobody finishes, rest of podium by lowest sum of positions with motocross tie-break, optional Ironman clause; per-class settings. Also a Points + Wins + Last Race variant.
